text: DSH Chat Import（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：把多种 AI 编程助手的历史会话迁入 DeepSeek Harness，让用户在 DSH 中接着对话。它通过导入工具、命令和网页侧栏面板接入，并把不同来源的记录转换为 DSH 会话；支持 Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini 等来源，提供扫描发现、预览、批量与增量导入、会话导出和便携包备份还原。还可检查已导入会话并管理导入记录。适合更换编程助手后继续旧对话，或在 DSH 与其他客户端间迁移会话的用户。需要 DSH 及本机可访问的源会话文件或数据库，不需要额外 API Key。

DSH Chat Import brings local coding-agent histories into continuable DSH sessions. Its web panel and tools support discovery, preview, batch import, export, and portable backup and restore. For developers moving conversations into DSH; it uses local files and needs no extra API key.

已经导入的会话怎么检查结构，或者撤销导入？

Convert local coding-agent histories into continuable DSH sessions by selecting a format and source file or directory.
Discover local sessions and batch import selected conversations through the panel or the import-all command.
Track imports and re-run them to append new transcript content; unchanged sources can take a short path.
Preview a sample of a converted session in the panel before importing it as a DSH conversation.
Export a DSH session to Claude Code, Codex, Kimi CLI, or OpenCode format, with preview serialization.
Create portable session bundles and restore them later as continuable DSH conversations.
Verify session structure, list tracked imports, and retract an import by session or source path.
Use a web panel to discover sessions and import files, or slash commands to import one source or a batch.

dsh-chat-import README · Install：> Requires dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 or newer. Verified on the 0.1.x line and on the 0.2.x line; dsh-tools must satisfy `>=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.3.0`.

1. Install from a terminal

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chat-import                    # npm package
```

2. Or install from the [Plugin Marketplace](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)

dsh-chat-import README · Usage：1. Import conversations from the GUI

Click the **Import sessions** button at the bottom of the left sidebar to open the import window. With the DSH Claude Style theme, that button lives in the account menu at the bottom left. Pick the conversations you want and import them in one click.

dsh-chat-import README · Usage：Rows carry their own tools: **double-click** a row to preview the conversation (a read-only dry-run — plugin injections skipped, tool calls folded into one line), switch the search box to **In content** to search message bodies instead of titles, **hide** a row reversibly, move a single-session source file to the Recycle Bin, or **drag the row onto a workspace** in the left sidebar to import it there with its timestamps shifted so it sorts to the top. The exact rules are in [docs/USAGE.md](docs/USAGE.md).

dsh-chat-import README · Usage：If the file came from somewhere else — a web-app export, a script you wrote, a tool this plugin does not list — use **Import from file** at the top of the same window. Type a local path and press Enter, or press **Choose…** to pick files. When the path is a directory, it asks whether to search subfolders. Check the preview, then import. If detection fails, it lists why each candidate parser gave up and points you at the skill that converts the format.

2. Import through an agent's tool call

```

dsh-chat-import README · Example call formats：import_chat({ format: "claude", path: "~/.claude/projects" })
import_chat({ format: "chatgpt", path: "~/Downloads/chatgpt-export/conversations.json" })
import_chat({ format: "local-jsonl", path: "D:\downloads\session.jsonl" })
```

dsh-chat-import README · Example call formats：Cursor workspace grouping and imports prefer the local Cursor workspace registry by conversation id, accepting only existing directories. Imports always read fresh; discovery caches successful reads and invalidates on DB/WAL changes. Malformed JSON and filesystem failures are counted in diagnostic warnings. When no usable entry exists, they fall back to decoding the transcript's project directory name.

dsh-chat-import README · Configuration：To accommodate TUI users, the tools this plugin provides start out injected into context. In Settings you can switch them to **not injected**, or to a partial injection, which saves a fair number of tokens.

Full tool and command usage is in **[docs/USAGE.md](docs/USAGE.md)**.

dsh-chat-import README · Configuration：Third-party plugins can call `scanDiscover()`, `importPath()`, `importAll()`, and `resumeSummary()` on the optional `chatImport` host service. These reuse the same discovery, import, batch-import, and handoff-summary pipelines as the built-in tools and commands. A single-session import result includes `sessionId`. When the service is absent, callers should degrade gracefully.

dsh-chat-import README · Features：| Capability | Entry Point | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Import | Sidebar panel, "Import" tab | Import conversations from other agents, keeping reasoning, tool call results, and system prompts (optional) |
| Import from file | Panel "Import from file" / `/import auto <path>` | Any local file or directory: three-level detection (explicit format > content marker > parser trial), preview first, an optional search-subfolders prompt for directories, and, when every parser fails, a ready-to-send agent task brief plus a registered `dsh-chat-import-convert` skill |
| Retract Import | Sidebar panel, "History" tab | Review import history and delete sessions this plugin created |
| Export | Context tool | Serialize DSH sessions back into other agents' formats |
| Ignore | Automatic, plus `/ignores` | Archiving, deleting, or removing a workspace registers the source, so rescans skip it; `/ignore` and `/unignore` manage the table |

dsh-chat-import README · Features：Codex discovery prefers the session title saved in `session_index.jsonl` (`thread_name`), so a rename made in Codex still shows up. Only when no indexed title exists does it fall back to the first real user prompt, extracted the same way import does it, with injected page context excluded. The title index is streamed line by line, and the last valid title record wins for each session.

dsh-chat-import README · Features：For activity time, Codex discovery takes the latest valid timestamp found within bounded head and tail windows of the transcript and combines the results across rollout pages. File modification time is the fallback when the transcript carries no timestamp at all, so activity times still come back when the host file service does not expose modification times. A timestamp inside a truncated record can be missed.

dsh-chat-import README · Features：Claude Code fork sessions (from the newer desktop session menu and from `--fork-session`) are discovered and imported too. A fork transcript opens with a verbatim copy of the parent's records and appends its own from the fork point, so the main-transcript test looks at **both ends** of the file: if the file name's stem appears at either end, the file owns that session. Session identity is the **last** `sessionId` in the transcript. Before this rule, such files were classified as subagent auxiliary transcripts and skipped wholesale. The copied prefix, which is the parent's history, stays in the log, because a fork's context really does contain it; the parent and the fork therefore overlap by one stretch of history.

dsh-chat-import README · Features：On Windows, Hermes discovery scans `%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes` and `~/.hermes`, falling back to `~/AppData/Local/hermes` when `LOCALAPPDATA` is unset. On macOS and Linux it scans `~/.hermes`.

dsh-chat-import README · 使用：1. 通过 GUI 导入会话

点左侧栏底部的「导入会话」按钮打开导入窗口（用 DSH Claude Style 主题时，这个按钮收在左下角的账号菜单里），选好要导入的会话，一键导入。

会话行自带工具：**双击**行打开只读预览（跑的是导入的 dry-run，插件注入的消息不出现，工具调用折成一行）；搜索框可切到「**搜内容**」按正文检索；可以把行**隐藏**（可撤销）；可以把单会话来源的文件移进回收站；也可以把行**拖到左侧栏的工作区**上，导入到那个工作区并把时间轴平移到「现在」，让它排在最上面。规则细节见 [docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md](docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md)。

手上是别的工具导出的文件（网页版导出、自己写的脚本、列表里没有的工具）时，用同一个窗口顶部的「**从文件导入**」：填本机路径后回车，或者点「**选择…**」挑文件。路径是目录时会先问你要不要搜索子文件夹。预览确认之后再导入。识别不出格式时，会逐个列出候选解析器的失败原因，并给出把该格式转换过来的 Skill 指引。

Cursor 的工作区分组与导入优先按对话 id 查询本机 Cursor 工作区登记册，只采用现存目录。导入始终重新读取，发现缓存成功结果并在 DB/WAL 变化时失效；畸形 JSON 与文件系统读取失败会在诊断告警中计数。没有可用登记时，仍回退转录所在项目目录名的解码。

dsh-chat-import README · 配置：为了照顾 TUI 用户，插件提供的工具默认会注入上下文。你可以在设置页里把它们设成**不注入**或**只注入一部分**，这样能省下不少 token。

每个工具、每条命令的完整用法见 **[docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md](docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md)**。

第三方插件可以通过可选的 `chatImport` Host Service 调用 `scanDiscover()`、`importPath()`、`importAll()` 和 `resumeSummary()`。这四个方法复用与工具、命令相同的发现、导入、批量导入与交接摘要管线；单会话导入的返回值带 `sessionId`。服务不存在时，调用方要自己降级。

dsh-chat-import README · 功能一览：| 能力 | 入口 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 导入 | 侧边栏面板的「导入」页 | 从其他 Agent 导入对话，保留推理过程、工具调用结果和系统提示词（可选） |
| 文件导入 | 面板「从文件导入」/ `/import auto <path>` | 任意本地文件或目录：三级探测（显式格式 > 内容标记 > 逐格式试跑）、预览先行、目录会问要不要搜索子文件夹。识别失败时摊开各解析器的原因，一键复制可直接发给 Agent 的任务模板，并注册 `dsh-chat-import-convert` 转换 skill |
| 撤回导入 | 侧边栏面板的「历史」页 | 查看导入记录，一键删除本插件创建的会话 |
| 导出 | 上下文工具 | 把 DSH 会话序列化回外部 Agent 的格式 |
| 忽略 | 自动登记 + `/ignores` 命令 | 归档、删除、删工作区时自动登记源，重扫时跳过；用 `/ignore`、`/unignore` 管理忽略表 |

dsh-chat-import README · 功能一览：Codex 的会话标题优先取 `session_index.jsonl` 里保存的标题（`thread_name`），所以 Codex 里改过的名字也能显示。没有索引标题时，才按与导入共用的提取逻辑回退到首条真实提问，并排除注入的页面上下文。标题索引按行流式读取，同一会话取最后一条有效记录。

Codex 的活动时间取日志头尾有界窗口里最新的有效时间戳，并合并所有 rollout 分页的结果。只有日志里完全没有时间时才回退文件修改时间，所以宿主文件服务不提供修改时间也能取到活动时间。被窗口截断的记录里的时间戳可能漏掉。

dsh-chat-import README · 功能一览：Claude Code 的 fork 会话（新版桌面端会话菜单与 `--fork-session`）同样会被发现并导入。fork 转录把父会话的记录逐字拷贝在文件开头，自己的记录从 fork 点开始追加。所以判定主转录时看文件的两端：文件名 stem 出现在头部或尾部，就算这个文件自己的会话。会话身份取转录里最后出现的 `sessionId`。以前这类文件被整类当成子代理辅助转录跳过，一条都扫不到。拷贝过来的父会话历史会留在日志里，因为 fork 的上下文本来就有它，于是父会话与 fork 会话会重叠一段历史。

Hermes 在 Windows 上默认扫描 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes` 与 `~/.hermes`；`LOCALAPPDATA` 没有设置时，回退到 `~/AppData/Local/hermes`。macOS 与 Linux 默认扫描 `~/.hermes`。
